description: This file implements the core logic for the Open Content Decryption Module (OCDM) plugin in the WPEFramework, including memory observation, initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and connection management.

classes.name: MemoryObserverImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Exchange::IMemory interface that observes memory usage of a remote connection.

methods.name: MemoryObserver
methods.description: Creates a memory observer for a given remote connection.

methods.name: OCDM::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCDM plugin, setting up content decryption and memory observation.

methods.name: OCDM::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the OCDM plugin, releasing resources and unregistering notifications.

methods.name: OCDM::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: OCDM::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently no implementation.

methods.name: OCDM::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests directed at the OCDM plugin, returning system info, sessions, or designators.
